notes.subject: test: fail closed when Vitest home isolation is unsafe
notes.summary: Test-only helper now refuses to run Vitest if home directory isolation is unsafe (e.g. threads pool), with no change to shipped extension or desktop behaviour.

notes.subject: feat(feedback): delete feedback from disk instead of hiding it
notes.summary: Deleting development feedback now permanently removes the report, its full-content file and triage history from disk (with locking and index renumbering), and purges entries older builds only hid.

7435ae4f72a72625bc534d96bff6bcbf2a92dc09.summary: Test-only helper now refuses to run Vitest if home directory isolation is unsafe (e.g. threads pool), with no change to shipped extension or desktop behaviour.

47dea7cfcdeac25101b615a6671ea7c3f57d2b0a.summary: The /btw panel now supports follow-up questions in the side thread, replaces 'Add to conversation' with 'Send to chat' to send your message plus the side thread to the main agent, and raises per-question limits to 25 turns, 50 tool calls and 10 minutes.

01a855f6d21e8777358dd1534f5f7c27a8a15518.summary: Background agents spawned in one batch with overlapping owned paths are now rejected with workspace_conflict, writers waiting on workspace write access show as queued with the blocker, and read-only agents get clearer guidance about scripts.

cf5857f771495dee83fc721fa77cbe5e294f413d.summary: File approval cards now share one rule editor with folder-prefix defaults, outside-workspace write cards keep their layout, rule patterns wrap, and a new Allow Folder for Session button approves a file's folder in one click.

0dc88b64a80cf3e0976cdd81c4553d23578eb752.summary: The Approve for Me Guardian now receives host-measured diffs and session-edit facts for git checkout/restore file reverts, so it can approve restoring a session's own edits without the agent printing the diff first.

8e4ce15cf64a1c81a04a261f2b5b2c12929a26c2.summary: The browser gateway now remembers the last VS Code workspace and chat across visits, uses iPhone safe areas without wasting chat space, and moves Check for updates into the chat toolbar; also adds provider-editing docs and faster test runs.}

35a68166c2de8ed27a87dd47b3366fb485daaf9f.summary: Deleting development feedback now permanently removes the report, its full-content file and triage history from disk (with locking and index renumbering), and purges entries older builds only hid.
